dataSource: City of Cleveland Building Permits (ArcGIS open data), queried live
notes: Pulled live from Cleveland's ArcGIS open data feed on every search, not a static extract — coverage reflects whatever the city has published as of your search.
Matched by house number plus the first word of the street name; results may occasionally include unrelated records that happen to share both.
Permit number is not published in a consistently labeled way in this dataset and may appear blank.
summary: Cleveland is covered by a live query against the city's public building permits dataset, matched by address as you search.
